weather_report:
As the sun graces Boston with its gentle rays this morning, a crisp and radiant day unfolds. With a high expected near 55 degrees, the weather invites a pleasant embrace of outdoor activities, under a bright blue sky that offers the promise of warmth beneath the cool, fresh air. The wind whispers softly from the northeast, nudging leaves into a swirling dance, making the last hues of autumn all the more vivid against the cobalt expanse above.

In the cool hours of tonight, the temperature will dip, allowing frost to creep across the ground after 11 PM, urging those who venture outdoors to wrap themselves in cozy layers. For today’s revelers, a light jacket paired with comfortable jeans will suit the occasion, allowing one to transition seamlessly from the warmth of the sun to the brisk evening air. As dusk approaches, perhaps a leisurely stroll along the Charles River would be a wonderful choice—where one can savor the juxtaposition of city life against nature’s beautiful outskirts—or a quiet seat at a local café, sipping on a warm drink, absorbing the serene atmosphere as day turns to night.
